name: Vampirina
description: A young vampire girl faces the joys and trials of being the new kid in town when her family moves from Transylvania to Pennsylvania.

videos.title: Going Batty
videos.overview: Vampirina, also known as Vee, is very anxious about being able to make new friends after she and her family relocate from Transylvania to a new home in Pennsylvania, as she adjust to being the new kid in town, and adapting to the human world.

videos.title: Scare B&B
videos.overview: The B&B is open, but double booked with humans and vampires, causing problems.

videos.title: The Sleepover
videos.overview: Vee invites friends Poppy and Bridget for a sleepover, then realizes it's a full moon.

videos.title: Portrait of a Vampire
videos.overview: Vee becomes a bat while having her photo taken.

videos.title: Vee's Surprise Party
videos.overview: Vee invites her class over for a party full of spooky surprises.

videos.title: Vee Goes Viral
videos.overview: While trying to learn a new dance, Vee unknowingly teaches her friends a dance that gets the attention of a competitive ghoul, Dragos the Dancer.

videos.title: The Plant Predicament
videos.overview: Edna enters a Green Thumb Contest and accidentally plants some of Oxana’s magical Transylvanian seeds.

videos.title: Mummy Mayhem
videos.overview: When Vee goes on a field trip to the Natural History Museum, she runs into an old family friend, King Pepi.

videos.title: Little Terror
videos.overview: Vee and her friends volunteer to babysit for her baby cousin.

videos.title: Super Natural
videos.overview: When a family of ghost hunters comes to stay at the Scare B&B, Vee and her family spend the day trying to prove that their house is not haunted.

videos.title: Vamping Trip
videos.overview: Vee and her family go on a camping trip

videos.title: The Monster Snore
videos.overview: A monster gets lost on his way to the Scare B&B and ends up at the wrong house.

videos.title: Bone Appetit
videos.overview: Demi brings the infamous Chef Remy Bones to the Scare B&B to help with the meal preparations.

videos.title: Woodchuck Woodsies
videos.overview: Vee joins Poppy and Bridget at a Woodchuck Wooodsie event.

videos.title: Hide & Shriek
videos.overview: Vee invites her friends over for a game of "hide and shriek".

videos.title: The Little Witch
videos.overview: The most famous witches in all of Transylvania come to stay at the Scare B&B with their adorable daughter, Phoebe.

videos.title: Vampire Weekend
videos.overview: During a full moon, Vee and Poppy magically switch places and Vee transforms into a human and Poppy into a vampire.

videos.title: The Bird Who Knew Too Much
videos.overview: When Vee and Poppy’s class pet comes to stay at the Scare B&B, they have to stop the bird from revealing too much about the haunted house to Poppy’s brother, Edgar.

videos.title: The Ghoul Girls
videos.overview: Vampirina’s favorite band, The Scream Girls, comes to stay at the Scare B&B and help Vee and her friends overcome their stage fright.

videos.title: Game Night
videos.overview: Vee invites her friends over for family game night and teaches them some of her favorite Transylvania games.

videos.title: Oldie but a Ghouldie
videos.overview: Gregoria worries she'll be thrown away when the family does some spring cleaning.

videos.title: Beast in Show
videos.overview: Vampirina takes Wolfie to a dog show.

videos.title: Critters!
videos.overview: Wolfie Shrinks, So, Vee and Gregoria get a Critternarian for help.

videos.title: Cuddle Monster
videos.overview: A Monster named Buttons stays at the Scare B&B.

videos.title: Batty Fever
videos.overview: When Vee and the rest of the family catch Batty Fever, Demi and Gregoria must work together to brew a potion to cure them.

videos.title: Poetry Day
videos.overview: Vee helps Bridget practice for Poetry Day.

videos.title: Nanpire the Great
videos.overview: Vee’s grandmother, Nanpire, visits from Transylvania and helps her cook a traditional vampire dish for the class potluck.

videos.title: Two Heads Are Better Than One
videos.overview: The Scare B&B gets a two-headed guest just in time for the Friendship Festival.

videos.title: Vee Is for Valentine
videos.overview: Vee tries to celebrate Valentine's Day and Ghoulentine's Day but mixes up her cards.

videos.title: Scarestitute Teacher
videos.overview: Oxana steps in when Mr. Gore needs a substitute teacher.

videos.title: Look Who's Scared Now!
videos.overview: Vee and her family get scared during the town's anniversary celebrations.

videos.title: Dust Bunnies
videos.overview: It is time to give the house its one-hundred year clean. While her parents leave to buy some cleaning accessories, Vee and her friends are left to clean the house. Demi tries to use magic to clean the house faster, but instead conjures up Dust Bunnies who begin to wreak havoc.

videos.title: Vampirina Ballerina
videos.overview: Vee gets stage fright during a ballet performance.

videos.title: Treasure Haunters
videos.overview: Vampirina and her friends help a ghost pirate search for treasure so that he can be freed from a haunted map.

videos.title: Mummy's Day
videos.overview: Oxana becomes another guest in her own Terror Pension to celebrate Mummy's Day.

videos.title: Dance-lvania
videos.overview: Vampi gives a dance at the Terror Pension to celebrate Danzilvania Day.

videos.title: Acrobat Boris
videos.overview: Boris receives an invitation to meet with the Murciacróbatas, a group of aerial acrobatics.

videos.title: The Lemonade Stand
videos.overview: With a little help from Chef Remy, Vee and Poppy run an irresistible lemonade stand.

videos.title: Hiccupire
videos.overview: When Vampi gets a vampire hiccup attack, Poppy and Bridget have a hard time figuring out how to take it away from a scare.

videos.title: Uncle Bigfoot
videos.overview: The roommate at Boris University, Bigfoot, is staying at the Terror Pension.

videos.title: Fangless
videos.overview: When the milk fangs fall, Vampirina is afraid of not growing back.

videos.title: Transylvanian Tea
videos.overview: When Vampinana teaches Vampirina the family tradition of organizing tea snacks, Vampi tries to make her first snack perfect.

videos.title: Home Scream Home
videos.overview: Vampi and her friends go to Transylvania to participate in the Zombix Factor talent contest!

videos.title: Countess Vee
videos.overview: Vampirina learns that she has been named heir to Uncle Dieter's castle, what makes her a Countess!

videos.title: Frights, Camera, Action!
videos.overview: Vampi, Poppy and Bridget help Edgar make a monster movie for the school film festival.

videos.title: Hauntleyween
videos.overview: Vampirina and her family invite their Transylvanian friends to celebrate Halloween in Pennsylvania.

videos.title: Frankenflower
videos.overview: Vee comes up with an invention to bring a flower back to life for her school's inventor fair.

videos.title: Nanpire and Grandpop the Greats
videos.overview: Nanpire and Grandpop the Great visit to celebrate the Blood Moon Festival.

videos.title: There's Snow Place Like Home
videos.overview: When Vee doesn't get the snow day she was hoping for, Demi casts a spell to help.

videos.title: Vampire for President
videos.overview: Vampirina decides to run for class president.

videos.title: Where's Wolfie?
videos.overview: Poppy wants a pet bunny, but first she has to show her mom she is ready to have a pet by looking after Wolfie.

videos.title: The Woodsie Way
videos.overview: Vee and her friends go on their first hiking trip with the Woodchuck Woodsies.

videos.title: TNN
videos.overview: One of Vee's oldest friends from Transylvania, Frankie Bolt, comes to visit her in Pennsylvania.

videos.title: Franken-Wedding
videos.overview: Frankenstein and the Bride of Frankenstein hold their wedding at the Hauntley’s Scare B&B and give Vampirina a very important job.

videos.title: Bat Hair Day
videos.overview: Gregoria’s sculpture of the Hauntley family is almost ruined when Vee wakes up with a bat hair day.

videos.title: Baby Dragon
videos.overview: A baby dragon visits the Hauntley’s and takes a special liking to Gregoria.

videos.title: Gloomates
videos.overview: When the Hauntley house becomes infested with Charmer bugs, Edna insists the entire family stay with her while the house is being fumigated.

videos.title: The Ghoul Next Door
videos.overview: Vampirina, Poppy and Edgar get new neighbors.

videos.title: Scare B & Vee
videos.overview: While her parents are away, Vampirina volunteers to be in charge of running the Scare B&B.

videos.title: The Birthday Broom
videos.overview: Vee is gifted a Hover Haunt Spook-Thousand broom on first birthday in Pennsylvania.

videos.title: Vee Takes The Court
videos.overview: Vee volunteers to sub in on Poppy's basketball team to help win the final game.

videos.title: Scare-itage Day
videos.overview: Family Heritage Day is coming up at school and Vee is excited to make a family tree.

videos.title: The Great Egg Scramble
videos.overview: Vee’s first Easter egg hunt turns into a rescue mission after a baby dragon egg accidentally gets mixed in with the other eggs.

videos.title: Desserter Mystery
videos.overview: The Hauntleys travel to Spookelton castle to celebrate Nanpire's birthday, and Vee makes her a special cake.

videos.title: Mirror Mirror
videos.overview: When Vee starts to feel overwhelmed by all she has to do, Demi introduces her to a magic mirror that can create duplicates of herself.

videos.title: Beach Night
videos.overview: Vampirina and her family invite their neighbors on a trip to the beach.

videos.title: Gregoria Takes Flight
videos.overview: Vee and Demi attempt to teach Gregoria how to fly so that she can view a rare star constellation.

videos.title: The Big Bite
videos.overview: Chef Remy Bones competes in a TV cooking competition for humans.

videos.title: Ghost Hosts
videos.overview: Vampirina and her friends fill in as hosts of Edgar's "Weekly Weirdness" show when he becomes sick.

videos.title: The Boo Boys Are Back
videos.overview: The Ghoul Girls and Poltergeist Pat perform at the Paranormal Pop Festival.

videos.title: Pixie Problem
videos.overview: Vee practices a new shrinking spell when a pixie family visits the Scare B&B.

videos.title: Face the Music
videos.overview: Poppy writes a song for the Ghoul Girls to perform in the school talent show.

videos.title: Fright at the Museum
videos.overview: Vee and her friends are invited to a sleepover at the museum hosted by King Pepi.

videos.title: Vamp-iversary
videos.overview: It's Boris and Oxana's anniversary and no one is more excited to celebrate her parents than Vee.

videos.title: Wolf Boy
videos.overview: The Hauntleys have a new guest at the Scare B&B, a wolf boy named Fangbert.

videos.title: Bat Got Your Tongue
videos.overview: Vampirina loses her voice just before a Ghoul Girls performance in Translyania.

videos.title: Haunted Theater
videos.overview: Vee, Bridget and Poppy meet a friendly but dramatic ghost on a field trip to a haunted theater.

videos.title: Trick or Treaters
videos.overview: It's Halloween, and Vampirina is excited to go trick or treating with friends for the first time.

videos.title: Play It Again Vee
videos.overview: Demi casts a time loop spell to help prevent Vee's project from being destroyed.

videos.title: Jumping Jack-o-Lanterns
videos.overview: Vee goes overboard growing the largest pumpkin for a carving contest.

videos.title: Freeze Our Guest
videos.overview: When the Tundra-nator breaks at the B&B, Oxana accidentally starts a winter storm in the middle of a heat wave.

videos.title: Vamp-opera
videos.overview: When Vee attempts to use a hybrid spell to help with her writer's block, she accidentally turns the world into a Sung-through musical and has to find a way to break the curse.

videos.title: Día De Los Muertos
videos.overview: A family of Caracas visit for Día de los Muertos and teach the Hauntleys about their traditions.

videos.title: As You Wish
videos.overview: Vee's identity is threatened when Edgar gets his hands on a cupcake that make wishes come true once eaten.

videos.title: The Scare Council
videos.overview: Boris becomes head of the Transylvania Scare Council but the members reject his park idea.

videos.title: Taking Scare of Business
videos.overview: Vee and her friends help Demi complete his list of unfinished business.

videos.title: The Hauntley Girls
videos.overview: A magical book wrecks havoc at the Scare B&B's first book club read.

videos.title: The Not So Haunted House
videos.overview: Poppy thinks her family is moving, so Vee and the others try to make her house look haunted.

videos.title: A Gargoyle Carol
videos.overview: Vee and family embrace the human ways of Christmas but Gregoria feels differently.

videos.title: Deliver-eeek!
videos.overview: The Hauntleys discover a new delivery service that delivers specialty items from Transylvania.

videos.title: The Great Esmeralda
videos.overview: A visiting fortune teller predicts Vee will "lose a friend", and she believes it's her friendship with Poppy.

videos.title: Frog's Breath
videos.overview: A potion gone wrong turns Vee into a frog and is found by Edgar.

videos.title: Oh Brother
videos.overview: Gregoria's soft and sweet brother, Hugo visits the Scare B&B, and Gregoria is jealous when he gets all the attention.

videos.title: The Search for Bigfoot
videos.overview: When Uncle Bob misses check in, Vee sets Edgar, Bigfoot's biggest fan, out to find him.

videos.title: Au Revoir Remy
videos.overview: When Remy says, "Au Revoir" to the Hauntley's to chase his dream as a chef at a fancy restaurant, a spookghetti monster pops up!

videos.title: The School Scare Fair
videos.overview: Oxana adds a spooky flair to the school fair.

videos.title: Ghoul Guides Save the Day!
videos.overview: When Edgar crashes the annual Ghoul Guides Extravaganza vamping trip in Transylvania, Vee and the girls must come clean about Vee's family. An excited Edgar reassures them that he will not tell anyone about the world of monsters.

videos.title: Weekly Normalness
videos.overview: When Edgar struggles with his new blog for the world wide cobweb, Vee, Gregoria and Demi help him come up with an idea.

videos.title: Vampire's Luck
videos.overview: Nan gives Vee a good luck charm for her ballet performance.

videos.title: A Key for Vee
videos.overview: The strings on Vee's spookylele pop off! In their search for new strings, the girls find something!

videos.title: Art Galler-eek!
videos.overview: Gregoria preps for an art galler-eek! show at the Monstropolitan Museum of Art.

videos.title: A Ghoulish Tour
videos.overview: The SCREAM GIRLS ask the Ghoul Girls to be their opening act in a multi-city Transylvania tour!

videos.title: Training Wings
videos.overview: Vee gets the battys after crash landing during a bicycle riding lesson!

videos.title: Nosy's Day In
videos.overview: Baby Nosy visits the Scare B&B and Vee can't wait to spend time with her!

videos.title: Sincerely, Blobby
videos.overview: Demi's pen pal, Blobby, checks into the B&B to meet him for the first time!

videos.title: Double Double Halloween Trouble
videos.overview: The Hauntley's must decide whether to trick or treat or attend the Boneyard Banquet that only happens every 100 years.

videos.title: The Creepover
videos.overview: Frankie comes to town so Vee hosts a creepover!

videos.title: Phantom of the Auditorium
videos.overview: The girls meet a phantom organ player at the Monster Hall of Music.

videos.title: Memoreek!
videos.overview: Demi and Gregoria cast a memory spell on Edgar that makes him forget monsters...and Vee!

videos.title: Weekend with Grandpop!
videos.overview: When Grandpop comes to bat-sit Vee, everyone is nervous because he's not used to human life.

videos.title: Haunted House Call
videos.overview: Demi gets sick and needs lots of love to cure him!

videos.title: The Critter Fair
videos.overview: Vee, Poppy, Bridget and Edgar volunteer for Dr. Paquette's Annual Critter Fair!

videos.title: Mirror Monster
videos.overview: The newest B&B guest has a hard time being himself and hides in the mirrors.

videos.title: Bust Friends
videos.overview: Edna gives the Hauntleys an old bust as decor for the neighborhood walking tour.

videos.title: The Invisible Fan
videos.overview: The Ghoul Girls have a busy day of back-to-back performances in Pennsylvania!

videos.title: Remy's Recipe
videos.overview: Remy gets featured in Edgar's latest Weekly Weirdness episode.

videos.title: Vampire Chaperone
videos.overview: When Boris volunteers to chaperone Vee's nature walk field trip, she hypes up his spookiness, only to be let down.

videos.title: Fang Ten!
videos.overview: A heat wave in Pennsylvania sends the Hauntley crew to Screech Beach, the spookiest monster beach in Transylvania!

videos.title: Science Rocks
videos.overview: Mr. Gore tasks the class with creating a rock-themed project.

videos.title: Aw, Shucks
videos.overview: Vee, Oxana, Poppy and Bridget throw a spooktacular garden party!

videos.title: Family Scareloom
videos.overview: Nanpire is visiting to store some old family scarelooms in the Hauntley's attic.

videos.title: Chrysalis Amiss
videos.overview: While gardening, Vee learns that the cutest creepy crawlies, caterpillars, don't stay caterpillars forever.

videos.title: Bringing Down the House
videos.overview: The B&B gets prepped for the Spook and See, an open house for monsters!

videos.title: Bat to the Future
videos.overview: When Esmeralda accidentally leaves her crystal ball, Crystal, at the B&B, Vee takes care of it!

videos.title: Gregoria Gets Down!
videos.overview: Vee and Demi find Gregoria practicing for the Monster Bop dance competition.

videos.title: Vee and the Family Stone
videos.overview: The Hauntleys are asked to walk the bat walk in Medusa's fashion show.

videos.title: Twin Trouble
videos.overview: The Hauntleys are asked to walk the bat walk in Medusa's fashion show. Poppy and Edgar can't agree on a theme for their birthday party.

videos.title: Bora the Banshee
videos.overview: A top music critic for The Rollling Bones visits the B&B to meet The Ghoul Girls!

videos.title: A Tale of Two Hollows
videos.overview: The Hauntley's prepare for their first ever Spooky Spa Weekend at the Scare B&B!

videos.title: The Fright Before Christmas
videos.overview: Vampirina plans a spooky scare in the hopes of attracting Spooky Claus so that her family can enjoy a festive Transylvanian Christmas.

videos.title: Scared Snowman
videos.overview: When the Abominable Snowman arrives at Scare B&B after a big snowstorm, Vee and her friends help him overcome some of his fears and discover that he's much braver than he imagined.

videos.title: New Century's Eve
videos.overview: The Hauntleys gather with Bridget and Poppy to watch the pumpkins drop and make resolutions on New Century's Eve.

videos.title: Bridget The Brave
videos.overview: Bridget finds a spellbook in the attic and accidentally casts a spell that makes her fearsome instead of fearless.

videos.title: Hauntley Home Movies
videos.overview: Demi and Gregoria help Vee with her school project, "What Was I Like As A Baby."

videos.title: Little Drummer Girl
videos.overview: Poppy tries to prevent herself from sneezing during a rock band, so she decided to replace herself for Octo to go with her place.

videos.title: The Magic Howl
videos.overview: Dr. Paquette arrives at the B&B to give all of the critters in the haunted house their routine check-ups and brings an expectant werewolf!

videos.title: Edgar the Ghoul Girl
videos.overview: Edgar is named an honorary Ghoul Girl!

videos.title: April Ghoul's Day
videos.overview: It's April Ghoul's Day and Vampirina invites over her friends to play some spooky pranks on them.

videos.title: Monster's New Bed
videos.overview: After the guest bed breaks, The Under the Bed Monster must approve any new beds.

videos.title: Making a Splash
videos.overview: Vee's best friend from Transylvania visits for the Firefly Festival, but gets too hot during a Pennsylvania heat wave!

videos.title: The Spelling Vee
videos.overview: Vee competes in the annual Transylvanian spelling bee!

videos.title: The Curious Case of the Giggles
videos.overview: Hydie Jekyll, a monster-kid scientist is in town in search of the final ingredient to her secret potion.

videos.title: International Treasure
videos.overview: Vee and her friends are invited to take part in special mummy traditions.

videos.title: Daddy's Littl Ghoul
videos.overview: Vee and Boris take a flight for Papa's day.

videos.title: Chef Remy’s Green Thumb
videos.overview: Chef Remy spruces up the backyard before Vee's Woodchuck Woodsies picnic.

videos.title: Home is Where the Hauntleys Are
videos.overview: When the Scare B&B is selected to receive a prestigious award by Edna and the Historical Society, the Hauntleys hurriedly prepare the house.
